capabilities.name: Recognize and write numbers up to 10000
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并书写10000以内的数
capabilities.description: Read, write, and identify numbers from 0 to 9999, including place value understanding.

capabilities.name: Compare numbers up to 10000
capabilities.name_zh: 比较10000以内的数的大小
capabilities.description: Use place value to compare and order numbers up to 4 digits.

capabilities.name: Count by multiples of 2, 3, 5, and 10
capabilities.description: Skip-count forward and backward by multiples of 2, 3, 5, and 10 up to 1000.

capabilities.name: Understand and use place value (units, tens, hundreds, thousands)
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用个、十、百、千的位值
capabilities.description: Break down numbers into thousands, hundreds, tens, and units, and recombine them.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract 2-digit and 3-digit numbers without regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 两位数或三位数加减（不进位、不借位）
capabilities.description: Perform addition and subtraction of 2-digit and 3-digit numbers without carrying or borrowing.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract 2-digit and 3-digit numbers with regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 两位数或三位数加减（进位、借位）
capabilities.description: Perform addition and subtraction of 2-digit and 3-digit numbers with carrying or borrowing.

capabilities.name: Multiply 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers without regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 两位数乘一位数（不进位）
capabilities.description: Perform multiplication of 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers without carrying.

capabilities.name: Multiply 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers with regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 两位数乘一位数（进位）
capabilities.description: Perform multiplication of 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers with carrying.

capabilities.name: Multiply 3-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 三位数乘一位数
capabilities.description: Perform multiplication of 3-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers, including carrying.

capabilities.name: Divide 2-digit or 3-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 两位数或三位数除以一位数
capabilities.description: Perform division of 2-digit or 3-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers, including remainders.

capabilities.name: Understand and use the distributive property for multiplication
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用乘法分配律
capabilities.description: Apply the distributive property (e.g., a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c) to simplify calculations.

capabilities.name: Use Associative and Commutative Properties for Addition and Multiplication
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用加法和乘法的结合律和交换律
capabilities.description: Rearrange and group addends or factors to simplify calculations.

capabilities.name: Perform mental addition and subtraction strategies
capabilities.name_zh: 心算加减法策略
capabilities.description: Use strategies like rounding, breaking apart, or compensation for mental addition and subtraction.

capabilities.name: Perform mental multiplication and division strategies
capabilities.name_zh: 心算乘除法策略
capabilities.description: Use strategies like breaking apart, factoring, or splitting for mental multiplication and division.

capabilities.name: Round numbers to the nearest 10, 100, or 1000
capabilities.name_zh: 四舍五入到十、百或千
capabilities.description: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand based on digit value.

capabilities.name: Estimate sums, differences, products, and quotients
capabilities.name_zh: 估算和、差、积、商
capabilities.description: Use rounding and simplification to estimate results of basic operations.

capabilities.name: Solve simple one-step equations
capabilities.name_zh: 解简单一步方程
capabilities.description: Solve equations like x + a = b or x × a = b using inverse operations.

capabilities.name: Solve two-step equations
capabilities.name_zh: 解两步方程
capabilities.description: Solve equations requiring two operations (e.g., 2x + 3 = 11).

capabilities.name: Identify and use multiples and factors of numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 识别和使用倍数与因数
capabilities.description: List multiples and factors of numbers and use them in problem-solving.

capabilities.name: Recognize common divisibility rules
capabilities.name_zh: 识别常见的整除规则
capabilities.description: Apply divisibility rules for 2, 3, 5, and 9 to determine if numbers are divisible.

capabilities.name: Extend arithmetic patterns with addition, subtraction, or multiplication
capabilities.name_zh: 扩展加减乘规律的数列
capabilities.description: Identify and extend numerical patterns (e.g., 4, 7, 10, 13...).

capabilities.name: Calculate the nth term of a simple arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 计算简单等差数列的第n项
capabilities.description: Find the term at a given position in an arithmetic sequence (e.g., term 10 of 4, 7, 10...).

capabilities.name: Calculate the sum of a simple arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 计算简单等差数列的和
capabilities.description: Calculate the sum of terms in an arithmetic sequence (e.g., sum of 1 to 24).

capabilities.name: Understand and use the concept of average for a set of numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用一组数的平均数概念
capabilities.description: Calculate and interpret the average (mean) of a dataset.

capabilities.name: Measure and calculate perimeter of polygons
capabilities.name_zh: 测量并计算多边形的周长
capabilities.description: Calculate the perimeter of rectangles, squares, and composite shapes.

capabilities.name: Measure and calculate area of rectangles and squares
capabilities.name_zh: 测量并计算长方形和正方形的面积
capabilities.description: Calculate the area of rectangles and squares using length and width.

capabilities.name: Understand and calculate the area of composite shapes
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并计算组合图形的面积
capabilities.description: Break down composite shapes into rectangles/squares to calculate total area.

capabilities.name: Recognize and classify angles (right, acute, obtuse)
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并分类角（直角、锐角、钝角）
capabilities.description: Identify and classify angles based on their measure (90°, <90°, >90°).

capabilities.name: Construct and measure angles using a protractor
capabilities.name_zh: 使用量角器构造和测量角
capabilities.description: Use a protractor to draw and measure angles in degrees.

capabilities.name: Understand and use the concept of parallel and perpendicular lines
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用平行线和垂线的概念
capabilities.description: Identify and draw parallel and perpendicular lines in geometric contexts.

capabilities.name: Identify, describe, and classify triangles
capabilities.name_zh: 识别、描述和分类三角形
capabilities.description: Classify triangles by side length (equilateral, isosceles, scalene) and angles (right, acute, obtuse).

capabilities.name: Count the number of triangles in a composite figure
capabilities.name_zh: 数组合图形中的三角形数量
capabilities.description: Count all possible triangles embedded in a complex geometric diagram.

capabilities.name: Use simple coordinate systems
capabilities.name_zh: 使用简单的坐标系
capabilities.description: Place and locate points on a grid using row and column labels or coordinates.

capabilities.name: Read and interpret bar graphs and line graphs
capabilities.name_zh: 阅读和解释条形图及折线图
capabilities.description: Extract and interpret data from bar graphs and line graphs.

capabilities.name: Create simple bar graphs and line graphs
capabilities.name_zh: 创建简单的条形图和折线图
capabilities.description: Organize and present data into bar graphs or line graphs.

capabilities.name: Calculate probabilities of simple events
capabilities.name_zh: 计算简单事件的概率
capabilities.description: Use basic probability concepts to determine the likelihood of simple events.

capabilities.name: Solve problems involving time
capabilities.name_zh: 解决时间相关问题
capabilities.description: Calculate time differences and solve problems involving hours, minutes, and seconds.

capabilities.name: Solve problems involving converting units of measurement
capabilities.name_zh: 解决单位换算问题
capabilities.description: Convert between units like meters/centimeters, kilograms/grams, or hours/minutes.

capabilities.name: Solve simple currency problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决简单货币问题
capabilities.description: Calculate sums and differences in currencies (e.g., yuan, jiao, fen).

capabilities.name: Use place value to decompose numbers for calculations
capabilities.name_zh: 使用位值分解数字进行简便运算
capabilities.description: Break down numbers into parts (e.g., 352 = 300 + 50 + 2) to simplify arithmetic operations.

capabilities.name: Recognize equivalences in expressions and rewrite them
capabilities.name_zh: 识别表达式的等价形式并改写
capabilities.description: Recognize equivalent arithmetic expressions and rewrite them (e.g., 125 × 72 = 125 × 8 × 9).

capabilities.name: Perform calculations using properties of operations
capabilities.name_zh: 使用运算性质进行简化计算
capabilities.description: Apply properties like distributive, associative, or commutative to simplify and solve calculations.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving age relationships
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决年龄关系问题
capabilities.description: Set up and solve equations based on relationships between ages (e.g., 6 years ago, in 6 years).

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving speed, distance, and time
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决速度、距离和时间问题
capabilities.description: Solve problems using the formula Distance = Speed × Time.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving ratios
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决比例关系问题
capabilities.description: Solve problems where quantities are directly related (e.g., twice, three times, half).

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve part-whole problems (sum and difference of parts)
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决部分整体问题（部分和与差）
capabilities.description: Solve problems where the total is known, and the parts are related by sums and differences.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving excess/deficit scenarios
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决盈亏问题
capabilities.description: Use surplus and deficit information to find unknown quantities (e.g., too much/too little scenarios).

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve reverse calculation (working backwards) problems
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决倒推计算问题
capabilities.description: Solve problems by working backwards from a given result to determine the starting value.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving overlapping sets (e.g., Venn diagrams)
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决重叠集合问题（如维恩图）
capabilities.description: Use principles of inclusion and exclusion to solve problems with overlapping groups.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving divisibility
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决整除问题
capabilities.description: Solve problems where divisibility conditions must be satisfied (e.g., divisible by 8 to modify a digit).

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems using enumeration
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并使用枚举法解决问题
capabilities.description: List all possible outcomes or combinations to solve a problem systematically.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve combinatorial problems (counting paths, arrangements)
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决组合问题（路径、排列计数）
capabilities.description: Count the number of arrangements, paths, or combinations (e.g., transport routes, seating).

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems using the Principle of Addition
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并使用加法原理解决问题
capabilities.description: Use addition to count multiple possibilities where cases are mutually exclusive.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems using the Principle of Multiplication
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并使用乘法原理解决问题
capabilities.description: Use multiplication to count multiple possibilities where cases are independent.

capabilities.name: Understand and create tree diagrams for simple counting
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并绘制简单计数的树状图
capabilities.description: Use tree diagrams to visualize and solve counting problems.

capabilities.name: Understand and use the Pigeonhole Principle
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并使用鸽巢原理
capabilities.description: Apply the pigeonhole principle to solve problems like 'guaranteeing a pair'.

capabilities.name: Understand and solve one-pen stroke problems (Eulerian paths)
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并解决一笔画问题（欧拉路径）
capabilities.description: Determine whether a shape can be drawn without lifting the pen or retracing lines.

capabilities.name: Calculate the number of diagonals in a polygon
capabilities.name_zh: 计算多边形的对角线数量
capabilities.description: Use formulas or counting methods to determine the diagonals in polygons.

capabilities.name: Recognize and solve problems involving symmetry
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并解决对称性问题
capabilities.description: Identify and apply symmetry properties in geometric and counting contexts.

capabilities.name: Use trial and error systematically in problem-solving
capabilities.name_zh: 在解决问题时系统地使用尝试法
capabilities.description: Organize trial and error to systematically test possibilities in counting or arithmetic problems.

capabilities.name: Solve problems using the concept of properties (e.g., one property corresponds to a multiple of another)
capabilities.name_zh: 使用属性关系概念解决问题
capabilities.description: Assign numerical relationships based on properties (e.g., age ratios, allocation rules).

capabilities.name: Recognize and use the concept of ‘folding’ or ‘doubling’ to reverse calculations
capabilities.name_zh: 识别并使用‘折半’或‘加倍’概念进行逆向计算
capabilities.description: Work backwards in problems involving halving or doubling to find initial values.

capabilities.name: Solve problems using before-and-after analysis
capabilities.name_zh: 使用前后分析法解决问题
capabilities.description: Analyze changes before and after a process to determine unknowns (e.g., shifts in quantities).

capabilities.name: Solve problems using line segment models for relationships
capabilities.name_zh: 使用线段模型表示关系解决问题
capabilities.description: Draw and use line segment diagrams to visualize and solve ratio or comparison problems.

capabilities.name: Understand and apply the concept of ‘total’ or ‘invariant’
capabilities.name_zh: 理解并应用‘总和’或‘不变量’概念
capabilities.description: Use the idea of an unchanging total quantity or invariant in solving problems.

capabilities.name: Recognize which operation to apply given a word problem
capabilities.name_zh: 根据文字题选择适当的运算
capabilities.description: Select the correct arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) based on the problem description.

capabilities.name: Validate arithmetic calculations
capabilities.name_zh: 验证算术计算
capabilities.description: Check calculations for accuracy using inverse operations or alternative methods.
